objective: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.

description: Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.
I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
progress: You have not yet performed your duty, <class>.  We cannot expect to carry out The Dark Lady's plan with the Scarlet Crusade pestering our soldiers.  Bring about their deaths and perform your duty to Sylvanas!
completion: You have done extremely well, <class>. With ruthless fighters like you conquering in the name of The Forsaken our race is one step closer to defeating Arthas once and for all. I have a good feeling about you, comrade.
